import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.PID

import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.Localization
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Integer
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
-- Required additional imports: Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.Localization
-- Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Integer; Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.FractionRing
#check_failure Roth.exists_nat_smul_eq_map
#check @MvPolynomial.isLocalization
#check @IsLocalization.exists_integer_multiple
#check @IsLocalization.exist_integer_multiples
#check @MvPolynomial.algebraMvPolynomial
#check @Int.natCast_natAbs
#check @Int.natAbs_of_nonneg
namespace ClearDenoms171
open MvPolynomial
theorem originalProbe171 {σ : Type*} (G : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) :
    ∃ (N : ℕ) (U : MvPolynomial σ ℤ), 0 < N ∧
      map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) U = (N : ℚ) • G := by
  let : Algebra (MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (MvPolynomial σ ℚ) :=
    MvPolynomial.algebraMvPolynomial
  obtain ⟨⟨_, n, hn, rfl⟩, U, hU⟩ :=
    IsLocalization.exists_integer_multiple
      ((Submonoid.pos ℤ).map (C (σ := σ))) G
  refine ⟨n.natAbs, U, Int.natAbs_pos.mpr (ne_of_gt hn), ?_⟩
  simpa only [MvPolynomial.algebraMap_def, Algebra.smul_def, map_C,
    Int.castRingHom_eq_intCast, Int.natCast_natAbs, abs_of_pos hn,
    smul_eq_C_mul] using hU

#print axioms ClearDenoms171.originalProbe171
end ClearDenoms171
